body.message:
Hi,I hope have a good day dear . 😊

As I mentioned, we are checking out today. The moving company has already arrived, and we are currently moving all of our belongings out of the apartment.

As I need to stay with the movers while they unload everything at our new place, I would appreciate it if you could please let me know the inspection time at least one hour in advance. Our new apartment is nearby, so I can come back and be present during the inspection.

Please let me know what time your team is planning to come today.
Thank you 🙏🏽
